subject: Physics
text: Which quantity is measured in newtons?
explanation: Newton is the SI unit of force.

subject: Physics
text: Why does an object moving at constant velocity have zero acceleration?

options.C: No forces exist in the universe

explanation: Acceleration measures the rate of change of velocity, so constant velocity gives zero acceleration.

subject: Physics
text: A 2 kg object accelerates at 3 m/s^2. What is the net force?
explanation: Using F = ma, the force is 2 x 3 = 6 N.

subject: Physics
text: A ball is thrown upward at 20 m/s. Ignoring air resistance and taking g = 10 m/s^2, after how many seconds does it return to the launch height?
explanation: Time up is v/g = 20/10 = 2 s, so total flight time back to the same height is 4 s.

subject: Chemistry
text: Which functional group is present in alcohols?
explanation: Alcohols contain the hydroxyl group, written as -OH.

subject: Chemistry
text: Why do alkanes generally have low reactivity?

options.A: They contain only strong C-C and C-H sigma bonds

explanation: Alkanes are saturated hydrocarbons with relatively strong nonpolar sigma bonds.

subject: Chemistry
text: Which product forms when ethene reacts with hydrogen in the presence of a nickel catalyst?
explanation: Hydrogenation adds hydrogen across the double bond, converting ethene to ethane.

subject: Mathematics
text: What is the derivative of x^2?
explanation: By the power rule, d/dx x^2 = 2x.

subject: Mathematics
text: What does a positive derivative at a point indicate about a function near that point?
explanation: A positive derivative indicates the function is increasing locally.

subject: Mathematics
text: If f'(x) = 3x^2 and f(0) = 2, what is f(2)?
explanation: Integrating gives f(x) = x^3 + C. Since f(0) = 2, C = 2, so f(2) = 8 + 2 = 10.

subject: Biology
text: Why can recessive traits disappear in one generation and reappear in the next?

options.A: Recessive alleles can be hidden in heterozygous carriers
options.D: Traits are selected randomly after birth

explanation: A recessive allele may be masked by a dominant allele in carriers and appear when inherited in two copies.

subject: Biology
text: Two heterozygous parents Aa x Aa have a child. What is the probability the child is aa?
explanation: The Punnett square gives AA, Aa, Aa, and aa, so aa occurs in 1 out of 4 cases.
